column2: [intro]
I’m a bit lazy, it’s true,
In my mind, everything’s in perfect disarray too.
But in the movies, oh, it’s all arranged,
I’m an expert, creatively deranged.
I only tidy things up in films,
In my life, chaos is my instinct's whims.
Objects fly, clothes get mixed up too,
In my world, disorder’s a challenge I pursue.
My socks don’t have their matches,
My keys hide in the news clippings' batches.
But in the films, it's always pristine,
I pretend, and it’s quite the scene.
I only tidy things up in films,
In my life, chaos reigns supreme.
Papers fly, glasses shatter with grace,
In my universe, nothing’s in its place.
[ solo ]
I’m an artist of the mess,
My disorder's my best success.
So I leave everything in disarray,
Because in movies, all is perfect, they say.
[outro]
